These two SOL files were written by the preserved Elona Shooter Plus game under
Ruffle 0.7.1 on 2026-11-02, then downloaded through Ruffle's Save Manager. They are
not generated by the port's AMF fixture encoder and contain no player's private save.

Source: `elonashooter1.3-fixed.swf`, SHA256
`bf573da9f6dc7dae9538ccc3e458b1eba80dc7947ad16f520fde62388b3c4363`.
Only the existing startup compatibility fix differs from the preserved original;
`docs/verification.json` records unchanged non-code resources.

A fresh isolated origin ran ordinary New Game: Casual Hunter, automatic firing,
loot/prize/skill/results, then town. The Small Gun2 skill was selected. A manual
town save produced `before-search.sol`: Day1, level2,806 GP,5/40 HP,29 total kills,
4 AP and search cursor446. One original Go searching action produced Rejoice!
and a second manual save:5 AP and cursor455, with money/income/HP unchanged.
Both files retain the original internal name `elonas0` and version1304.

The original Math.random stream was unseeded. Random values already stored in
these files are fixed regression inputs; future general RNG is not claimed to
match Flash. The persisted search cursor is an independent deterministic comparison.
This verifies one original-game/Ruffle save path, not every historical player file
or the native Adobe Flash runtime. Existing source-game credits remain applicable.
